title: Portable Fire Extinguishers — Performance and Construction — Specification
qco_name: Fire Safety Equipment (Quality Control) Mandatory Statutory Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Ministry of Home Affairs Fire Services

clauses.title: Operating Temperatures and Hydraulic Burst Pressure
clauses.text: Clause 6.1 & Table 1 (Extinguisher Pressure Ratings): The cylinder body of stored pressure fire extinguishers shall have a minimum hydraulic burst pressure of 5.5 MPa (55 bar) or 3 times the maximum operating service pressure. Operating temperature range: -20°C to +55°C for dry chemical powder ABC type; +5°C to +55°C for water and foam types.

clauses.title: Discharge Duration and Percentage Extinguishant Retention Limits
clauses.text: Clause 7.2 & Table 3 (Effective Discharge Requirements): Extinguishers shall discharge not less than 85% of their total rated chemical charge within: 4 kg ABC Powder = min 13 seconds; 6 kg ABC Powder = min 15 seconds; 9 kg ABC Powder = min 20 seconds. Range of discharge jet shall be not less than 4.0 metres for 6 kg/9 kg units.
